stories.headline: Huawei bids to export 1,408 Ascend 950 chips to Egypt as US assembles a counteroffer

key_facts.fact: Huawei responded to a tender from Cairo with a proposal to export 1,408 of its top-end Ascend 950-series chips for an AI training cloud, plus 600 more Ascend 950 or 910B chips for two inference clusters, under a 12-month buildout plan.
key_facts.excerpt: China's top competitor to Nvidia Corp. responded to a tender from Cairo with a proposal to export 1,408 of its top-end Ascend 950-series chips for an AI training cloud, plus 600 more of either those chips or the earlier 910B model to be used for two inference clusters... Huawei laid out a 12-month plan to build the infrastructure.

key_facts.fact: The data centers would serve military, surveillance and other public-sector uses, and the deal would be the first known export of Huawei's Ascend accelerators after more than a year of attempts.
key_facts.excerpt: Huawei Technologies Co has pitched the Egyptian government on building AI data centres for military, surveillance and other public sector use... It also could be the first known export of Huawei's Ascend accelerators after more than a year of attempts.

key_facts.fact: US officials are assembling a consortium including Nvidia, AMD and Microsoft to counter the bid; it may be the first time the US and China compete directly for the same government AI data center tender.
key_facts.excerpt: pulling together a US consortium... counter Huawei's AI chip bid... The process may be the first time the US and China have directly competed for the same government AI data centre tender.

key_facts.fact: The proposal is a partnership with iFlytek and includes vehicle and individual recognition tied to a national population database, presented in a 102-page deck; both firms have been on the US blacklist since 2019.
key_facts.excerpt: Huawei's Egypt proposal involves a partnership with iFlytek Co, the Chinese surveillance giant that along with Huawei has been blacklisted by the US since 2019. Among the firms' offerings are vehicle and individual recognition based on a national population database... On one slide of the 102-page presentation, examples of 'basic video applications' contain the insignia of China's Ministry of Public Security.

key_facts.fact: AI chip shipments to Egypt have required Washington's permission since 2023, and roughly 2,000 Huawei 950DT accelerators equal only a few hundred top Nvidia chips in training capability.
key_facts.excerpt: AI chip shipments to Egypt have required Washington's permission since 2023... Under typical parameters for training AI models, that quantity of Huawei 950DT accelerators would provide roughly the same capability as a few hundred of the top commercially available Nvidia chips.

stories.headline: HP licenses Huawei's Wi-Fi patents in a multi-year global cross-licensing deal

key_facts.fact: Huawei and HP announced on August 26, 2026 a multiyear global patent cross-licensing agreement that includes a license to HP for certain Huawei Wi-Fi patents.
key_facts.excerpt: [Shenzhen, China, August 26, 2026] Today, Huawei and HP Inc. announced the signing of a multiyear global patent cross-licensing agreement, including license to HP Inc. for certain Huawei WiFi patents.

key_facts.fact: The cross-license covers patents used in Wi-Fi technology including the latest Wi-Fi 7 standard, gives Huawei access to HP patents in return, and neither company disclosed financial terms.
key_facts.excerpt: China's Huawei Technologies said on Wednesday it had reached a multi-year cross-licence agreement with HP Inc, covering patents used in Wi-Fi technology, including the latest Wi-Fi 7 standard. The deal gives HP access to Huawei patents and gives Huawei access to HP patents, though neither company disclosed financial terms.

key_facts.fact: HP played down the deal, calling it a routine standard-essential patent license and 'not a broader strategic or commercial relationship, partnership, or collaboration with Huawei.'
key_facts.excerpt: "This is a standard-essential patent license covering Wi-Fi technology - something used broadly across the industry and routine for companies whose products connect to Wi-Fi. It is not new, does not represent a broader strategic or commercial relationship, partnership, or collaboration with Huawei," HP said.

key_facts.fact: The agreement follows Huawei's 2025 lawsuit against HP over Wi-Fi 6 patents; the dispute was resolved in November 2025 when HP joined Sisvel's Wi-Fi 6 pool of about 2,000 patents.
key_facts.excerpt: The agreement came after Huawei filed a lawsuit against HP in 2025 over Wi-fi 6 patents, but the disputes were resolved in November last year after the American PC maker became a licensee of the patent pool of Italian intellectual property management firm Sisvel.

key_facts.fact: The deal is a sign of adoption of Huawei technology outside China despite the US placing the company on its blacklist in 2019.
key_facts.excerpt: It's a sign of adoption of Huawei's technology outside China, despite the U.S. blacklisting the company in 2019, a move that restricted it from working with American suppliers such as Google.

stories.headline: Skild AI unveils S1, a robot model that learns 10-minute unseen tasks from a single video

key_facts.fact: Skild AI announced S1 on August 25, 2026: a robotic foundation model that takes a single video demonstration as its prompt and executes the task with no fine-tuning and no post-training.
key_facts.excerpt: Skild AI announced S1 on 25 August 2026, a robot foundation model that learns a new task from a single human video... S1 takes one egocentric human video as its prompt and carries out the task with no fine-tuning and no post-training, so the weights never change.

key_facts.fact: In a controlled comparison holding data, architecture and compute constant, the video-prompted model scored 66% on unseen tasks versus 9% for a language-prompted policy trained on the same 100,000-hour dataset.
key_facts.excerpt: The company reports a 66% success rate on unseen tasks, compared with 9% for a language-prompted model trained on the same 100,000-hour dataset.

key_facts.fact: Skild says one video demonstration was worth roughly 380 post-training episodes; the language-prompted model needed an estimated 380 demonstrations to match the in-context result.
key_facts.excerpt: The in-context model reached a 66% success rate from one prompt. The language-prompted model needed an estimated 380 post-training demonstrations to reach the same result.

key_facts.fact: The four demonstrated tasks absent from pre-training — plant potting, pancake cooking, pour-over coffee and kit assembly — run up to ten minutes and span dozens of manipulation steps, with unseen tasks showing a 7x gain over language prompting.
key_facts.excerpt: S1 performs tasks that run up to ten minutes and do not appear in the training data. ICL scaling gains over language prompting are moderate for seen tasks, but unseen tasks experience a 7x performance improvement.

key_facts.fact: There are no downloadable weights, no public API and no paper; Skild is deploying S1 with industrial partners including ABB Robotics, Universal Robots and MiR.
key_facts.excerpt: There are no downloadable weights, no public API, no licence and no pricing. Skild says it is deploying S1 with a limited set of industrial partners now... Its named robot OEM partners are ABB Robotics, Universal Robots and MiR.

key_facts.fact: S1 was trained on Nvidia AI infrastructure, and Skild says the model must infer the demonstrator's intent because the demo may come from a different scene, viewpoint or robot body.
key_facts.excerpt: Since the demonstration may come from a different scene, viewpoint, or embodiment, the policy must implicitly learn the demonstrator's intent, functional correspondences, and task progress... S1 is built on NVIDIA AI infrastructure.

stories.headline: Nvidia launches Jetson Orin Nano 2, doubling entry-level robot compute at 40% less power

key_facts.fact: Nvidia announced Jetson Orin Nano 2 on August 25, 2026 at Hot Chips, a robotics computer for entry-level edge AI aimed at robots, delivery and inspection drones, and vision AI systems.
key_facts.excerpt: August 25, 2026 - NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 2, a new robotics computer for entry-level edge AI, enables millions of developers worldwide to build robots, delivery and inspection drones, and vision AI systems for frontier physical AI applications.

key_facts.fact: The module delivers 78 trillion operations per second of AI compute with 8GB of memory and an 8-core Arm CPU.
key_facts.excerpt: Featuring 78 trillion operations per second of AI compute, 8GB of memory and an 8-core Arm CPU, Jetson Orin Nano 2 delivers a significant leap in AI and video-processing performance in a cost-effective, power-efficient system.

key_facts.fact: It offers 2x the inference performance of the Jetson Orin Nano Super in the same form factor, and in 15-watt mode consumes 40% less power for the same performance as its predecessor.
key_facts.excerpt: Jetson Orin Nano 2 achieves 2x the inference performance of Jetson Orin Nano Super through improved Tensor Cores and higher memory bandwidth, while maintaining the same compact form factor. In 15-watt mode, Jetson Orin Nano 2 consumes 40% less power to deliver the same performance as its predecessor.

key_facts.fact: More than 3 million developers have built on Nvidia's robotics stack, with Cognex, Doosan Bobcat and Matic among the first adopters; the module and developer kit are expected in the first half of 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: More than 3 million developers have built on the NVIDIA robotics stack, with Cognex, Doosan Bobcat and Matic among the first to adopt and explore Jetson Orin Nano 2... The NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 2 module and developer kit are expected to be available in the first half of 2027.

sources.title: NVIDIA Announces Jetson Orin Nano 2 Robotics Computer to Redefine Entry-Level Edge AI

stories.headline: India's AM Intelligence places binding order for 9,000 Nvidia Rubin GPUs for Hyderabad AI factory

key_facts.fact: AM Intelligence, the AI infrastructure platform set up by the promoters of Greenko, said on Tuesday, August 25, 2026 that it placed a firm and binding order for 9,000 Nvidia Rubin GPUs for its first AI factory in Hyderabad.
key_facts.excerpt: AI infrastructure company AM Intelligence on Tuesday (August 25, 2026) said it has placed a firm and binding order for 9,000 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs for its first AI factory in Hyderabad.

key_facts.fact: The GPUs will be deployed as Vera Rubin NVL72 rack-scale systems across 30 MW of capacity, with delivery scheduled for the first quarter of 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: The 9,000 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs, with their delivery slated in Q1 2027, are to be deployed as Vera Rubin NVL72 rack-scale systems at the 30 MW AI factory, making the facility one of the first frontier AI compute clusters in Asia.

key_facts.fact: Hyderabad is the first tranche of AMI's planned 1 GW of compute-as-a-service capacity across India, the US, Finland and Malaysia, with an initial 200 MW backed by more than $8 billion of capital expenditure.
key_facts.excerpt: the first tranche of its planned 1 GW Compute-as-a-Service platform across India, the US, Finland and Malaysia. The company plans to initially bring 200 MW of AI compute capacity to market, involving capital expenditure of more than $8 billion.

key_facts.fact: The Hyderabad facility is engineered to deliver roughly 450 exaFLOPS of NVFP4 inference compute, using Nvidia's new low-precision format and HBM4 memory.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 introduces NVFP4, a new low-precision computing format designed to run AI workloads more efficiently, alongside next-generation High Bandwidth Memory (HBM4). AMI said the Hyderabad AI Factory is being engineered to deliver approximately 450 exaFLOPS of NVFP4 inference compute.

key_facts.fact: Greenko founder Mahesh Kolli said the initial capacity has already been bought by an unnamed US customer, and the group aims to reach 5 GW of data center capacity by 2030.
key_facts.excerpt: The initial capacity has already been purchased by a US customer, he said, declining to identify the buyer because of a non-disclosure agreement... The company aims to reach 5GW of data center capacity by 2030 across India, Europe and elsewhere.

stories.headline: Samsung's 4nm line hits 80%+ yield on Nvidia's Groq 3 LPX, a turning point for its foundry

key_facts.fact: Nvidia's Groq 3 LPX inference accelerator, announced as being in mass production at Hot Chips 2026, is being made on Samsung Electronics' 4-nanometer process at the S5 line of its Pyeongtaek campus.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia announced at the 'Hot Chips 2026' semiconductor conference that the Grok3 AI inference accelerator, a language processing unit (LPX), has entered mass production, and the chip is being produced on the 4-nanometer process at Samsung Electronics' S5 line at its Pyeongtaek campus.

key_facts.fact: Yield on the chip has improved roughly two- to threefold since April, rising above the 80% benchmark for stable mass production, while utilization of the Pyeongtaek 4nm line has approached 100%.
key_facts.excerpt: Grok3's production yield has improved roughly two- to threefold recently compared with April, rising above 80%, the benchmark for stable mass production, while the utilization rate of the Pyeongtaek 4-nanometer line has approached 100%. This trend is providing a turning point for the foundry business, which has run losses for a long time.

key_facts.fact: Samsung is also supplying sixth-generation HBM4 for the Rubin GPU, SOCAMM2 low-power DRAM modules for the Vera CPU, and NAND-based SSDs, widening its role in Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform from components to full AI hardware.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electronics is also broadening the scope of its cooperation with Nvidia by supplying HBM4 for the Rubin GPU, 'SOCAMM2' low-power DRAM modules for the Vera CPU, and NAND flash-based SSDs.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia said on August 24 that Groq 3 LPX is now in full production as an extension of the Vera Rubin platform, with Nebius the first AI cloud to adopt it.
key_facts.excerpt: PALO ALTO, Calif., Aug. 24, 2026 -- Hot Chips—NVIDIA today announced that NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX, the interactive AI inference accelerator, is now in full production. An extension of the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform... Nebius, a leading AI cloud, plans to bring NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX to Nebius Token Factory.

stories.headline: LG CNS and Naver Cloud to build direct-to-chip liquid cooling for Korea's largest AI factory

key_facts.fact: LG CNS announced on August 26, 2026 that it will build direct-to-chip liquid-cooling infrastructure with Naver Cloud at its Samsong data center, an 80-megawatt site set to rank among South Korea's largest AI factories.
key_facts.excerpt: LG CNS said on Aug. 26, 2026, that it will build direct-to-chip liquid-cooling infrastructure with Naver Cloud at its Samsong data center, an 80-megawatt facility set to rank among South Korea's largest AI factories.

key_facts.fact: The cooling system is designed to run Nvidia's next-generation Vera Rubin GPUs, owned by the state-backed National IT Industry Promotion Agency and operated by Naver Cloud, with construction and validation targeted for completion in 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: The infrastructure is designed to run Nvidia's forthcoming Vera Rubin GPUs, owned by the state-backed National IT Industry Promotion Agency, which Naver Cloud will operate... with construction and testing targeted for completion in 2027.

key_facts.fact: Liquid cooling is becoming mandatory as high-density GPU racks exceed 200 kW, far beyond the 20-30 kW per rack that air cooling can handle.
key_facts.excerpt: While conventional air-cooling methods can handle a cooling capacity of around 20–30 kW per rack, the power density of high-performance GPU server racks is rising to over 200 kW, making DTC technology an essential element in the construction of AI factories.

key_facts.fact: Vera Rubin racks are expected to deliver about 3.3 times the inference performance of Nvidia's current Blackwell Ultra generation.
key_facts.excerpt: Vera Rubin racks are expected to deliver about 3.3 times the inference performance of Nvidia's current Blackwell Ultra generation.

key_facts.fact: The global data center liquid cooling market is projected to grow from $4.07 billion in 2026 to $27.65 billion by 2033, according to MarketsandMarkets.
key_facts.excerpt: According to market research firm MarketandMarket, the global data center liquid cooling market is expected to grow rapidly from $4.07 billion in 2026 to $27.65 billion by 2033.
